general.summary: For all its bluster about spending cuts, Chile’s market-friendly government lacks ambition when it comes to controlling a debt load that has doubled in the past decade, according to economists in a panel hosted by Bloomberg News.

general.title: India’s Inflation Rises, Keeping Rate-Hike Pressure on RBI
general.summary: India’s inflation accelerated to its highest level in two years in October, breaching the top of the Reserve Bank’s 2%-6% tolerance band and adding pressure on policymakers to raise interest rates further.
